headline: EPS falls sequentially but rises year-over-year
summary_short: Hyundai Engineering & Construction reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of ₩1,036, down 32.9% q/q from ₩1,543 but up 23.2% y/y from ₩841.
summary_long: EPS of ₩1,036 fell 32.9% sequentially from ₩1,543 but rose 23.2% year-over-year from ₩841. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
